name: documentary
label: Documentary (history, true stories, deep dives)
description: Long-form narrated deep dive: slower pacing, archival and public-domain footage first, few cards.
_scenes: Documentaries breathe: longer shots than a listicle.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).
stock._sources: Archival / public-domain film first, then CC video, then stock.

llmGuidance: Documentary narration (history, true stories, disasters, psychology). Prefer real places, people's surroundings, period objects and archival-looking shots of what the narration describes; name the era or place in the search when the narration gives it (e.g. '1930s factory workers', 'ocean liner at sea'). Avoid modern-looking stock for historical moments. Use graphics only for a date, a place name or one key number.
